findings.passage: “There is always a backlash to our efforts to claim progress, and to have any sort of semblance of equality,” she told NPR.
findings.note: She is quoted (by WPLN, repeating an NPR interview; the page is stamped 2024-10-05 but the quote concerns a law signed in May of an earlier year, so the date of the words is unknown) on the Tennessee law adding rules and fines for groups that run voter registration drives. She says it responds to a 2018 registration campaign by the Tennessee Black Voter Project. Related to the subject only as voter-registration rules; it says nothing about ID or citizenship proof.
Listed as prime sponsor of SB0285 (113th General Assembly) in LegiScan's bill record (sponsor order 1); the first version (2652136-Draft) carries the ID/citizenship text (identity step 2026-11-12).
